program:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
remind "Check your habits" at 20:00
form habit
describe:
Habits, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- habit: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- check: habit: a habit. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many habit entries.
- done is how many check entries today.
Shows:
- done out of n with a progress bar, labelled "done today".
- text: "All done today" when done is n and n is more than 0, otherwise "Keep going".
- text: "Best streak", the highest of the current day streak of its check entries over the habit, "days".
- if n is 0:
  - text: "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day.".
- for each habit:
  - a group; a tap opens the habit for editing; a swipe removes the habit, with undo:
    - text: the name of the habit.
    - text: the current day streak of the habit's check entries, "days".
    - a tick box for the check of the habit.
    - for each day in the last 7 days:
      - a group; a tap marks or unmarks the check of the habit on that day:
        - text: the weekday of the day.
- a form to add a habit.
Reminder "Check your habits" at 20:00 every day.

remind "Check your supplies" at 9:00 on sat
